# Dev notes

What `dev` has gained since the last release, one line per change. CONTRIBUTING.md, "Dev notes", shows how to add yours.

---

Lua
- coe5.openTestField: empty fields and five terrains
- 22 new test field calls: a unit's items and spells, battle cells on screen, the field after a fight
- coe5.loadedContentOrigin: which mod made or last changed an item, spell or magic path
- coe5.ui.drawMonsterSprite and drawItemSprite: a monster's or item's sprite at any size
- coe5.monsterHasRanged: at the main menu, and on Mac
- Mac: all of these but allowMultipleUnique and coe5.inspectTestFieldItem (for now)
